text:
frank.p: Quick sync — proposing a short pilot to test a vendor-pass-through exemption for reseller accounts next billing cycle. Goal: measure customer impact without altering vendor settlements. Need ops + sales exceptions flow.

zara.m: Clarify exemption rule: which customers qualify as reseller? We have customer.type=reseller OR partner_account tag. Also exclude grandfathered=true.

henry.l: Ops implications: do NOT change the vendor payout lines. Instead create an internal adjustment line: acct 7010 vendor_subsidy with memo 'pilot_pass_through_exempt'. We'll keep original vendor_settlement untouched.

frank.p: Agreed. Sales asks for a whitelist path so they can nominate customers quickly. Proposal: SFDC case with tag "pass_through_nominate" and a CSV upload to the shared drive. Auto-approve if ARR < 20k; finance review otherwise.

billing-bot: [automated] Pilot scheduled: pass_through_exempt_pilot | start=2026-10-03 | cohort=reseller_candidates | id=exp_pt_20261003

zara.m: For invoicing: add invoice.metadata.pilot_id, invoice.metadata.pass_through_exempt=true, and invoice.line.note='pass-through exemption applied'. Also include invoice.metadata.export_hash so we can trace exports back to the run.

henry.l: We'll implement a shadow export first: compute net_due_shadow while keeping live invoices unchanged. Shadow CSV fields: customer_id, net_due_live, net_due_shadow, est_vendor_delta, sponsor_gl_account. No invoice mutations during shadow.

frank.p: Success criteria: median customer delta < 3%, fewer than 4 customers >10% delta, and no single customer >15k net change. If any threshold hit, halt and open postmortem.

salesops-bot: [automated] Received SFDC nominations: 8 rows. Reminder: please include ARR, vendor_contract_id, and grandfathering flag.

henry.l: Monitoring: add alert if est_vendor_delta != 0 for any non-exempt customer (should be zero). Also add dashboard for top 25 net deltas.

zara.m: One more edge case: prepaid/committed credits. If exemption causes net_due < 0, auto-generate credit_memo if abs(credit) < $750; else flag for manual review.

frank.p: Timeline: 1) shadow export Thursday 02:00 PT 2) review Friday 11:00 PT 3) canary (10 customers) Monday 09:00 PT 4) pilot roll for cohort Wednesday 08:00 PT. I'll post the whitelist template and SFDC flow in Drive.

billing-bot: [automated] Shadow export uploaded s3://redwood-finance/pilot_pass_through_shadow_1809998888.csv

zara.m: I'll draft the exemption email to customers and PR template for sales. If legal needs to approve exemptions >50k ARR, flag them ASAP.

frank.p: Thanks all — keep comments here. If anyone sees a missing piece in the shadow CSV DM me. :white_check_mark:
